facts.text: The Yeatman occupies a hillside position on the south bank of the River Douro.
facts.excerpt: Occupying a commanding hillside position on the south bank of the River Douro, every room at The Yeatman Hotel enjoys breathtaking views over the historic centre of Porto.

facts.text: Every room at The Yeatman has views over the historic centre of Porto.
facts.excerpt: every room at The Yeatman Hotel enjoys breathtaking views over the historic centre of Porto

facts.text: The Yeatman is set amidst the Port wine lodges, on a hill overlooking Porto, within 7 acres of land.
facts.excerpt: Set amidst the Port wine lodges, The Yeatman nestles on a hill, overlooking Porto and is set within 7 acres of land

facts.text: The hotel has outdoor and indoor infinity swimming pools.
facts.excerpt: has outdoor and indoor infinity swimming pools and Wine Spa

facts.text: All rooms and suites have a terrace or balcony with views over Porto.
facts.excerpt: All of our spacious rooms and suites have a terrace or balcony with views over Porto.

facts.text: The Yeatman is a member of the Relais & Chateaux collection of hotels.
facts.excerpt: Member of the prestigious Relais & Châteaux collection of hotels

facts.text: The Yeatman Gastronomic Restaurant holds two Michelin Stars, awarded in November 2016.
facts.excerpt: The Yeatman Gastronomic Restaurant at The Yeatman holds two Michelin Stars which were awarded in November 2016.

facts.text: Inspired by Porto's British wine-shipper heritage, the hotel blends Portuguese hospitality traditions with British flair for understated comfort.
facts.excerpt: Inspired by this heritage, The Yeatman Hotel blends the finest Portuguese traditions of hospitality with a uniquely British flair for understated and stylish comfort.

facts.text: Partner wineries sponsor individual rooms and suites, with pictures and objects about each winery in the guest rooms.
facts.excerpt: These partner wineries also sponsor individual rooms and suites. Intriguing pictures and objects provide insights into each winery's unique history and environment and add a discreet individual accent to each guest room.

facts.text: The cellars of The Yeatman house one of the most comprehensive collections of Portuguese wines.
facts.excerpt: The cellars of The Yeatman house one of the most comprehensive collections of Portuguese wines.

facts.text: Partner producers take part in the hotel's programme of tastings, seminars and wine dinners.
facts.excerpt: The hotel has established partnerships with many of Portugal's finest producers who actively participate in The Yeatman's programme of tastings, seminars and wine dinners.

facts.text: Visits can be arranged to vineyards and estates in the Douro Valley, Minho, Dao and Bairrada wine regions.
facts.excerpt: visits can be arranged to leading vineyards and estates in the Douro Valley, Minho, Dão and Bairrada wine regions, all easily accessible by road

facts.text: The wine theme extends to The Yeatman Wine Spa, with its exclusive skincare products and therapies.
facts.excerpt: The wine theme extends to The Yeatman Wine Spa with its exclusive skincare products and therapies.

facts.text: The Presidential Suite Panoramic has a private pool, barrel bed, spacious terrace and private garden.
facts.excerpt: The Hotel’s most luxurious suite with a private pool, barrel bed, spacious terrace and private garden, enjoying magnificent views over Porto and the Douro river.

facts.text: The Panoramic Deluxe Suites have a wider, panoramic view of the Douro River and the historic city of Porto.
facts.excerpt: Our Panoramic Deluxe Suites have a wider and panoramic view of the Douro River and the historic city of Porto.

facts.text: A romantic al fresco meal can be served on a guest's own private terrace.
facts.excerpt: A romantic al fresco meal can be served on a guest's own private terrace.

facts.text: The hotel does not recommend the Gastronomic Restaurant for children under 12; The Orangerie has a children's menu.
facts.excerpt: Please note that we do not recommend The Yeatman Gastronomic Restaurant for children under the age of 12 years old.

facts.text: The hotel's address is Rua do Choupelo, Santa Marinha, Vila Nova de Gaia, Porto.
facts.excerpt:
Rua do Choupelo, (Santa Marinha)
Vila Nova de Gaia

facts.text: The hotel's wine experts are on hand to guide guests in discovering Portugal's wine regions.
facts.excerpt: Guests are able to discuss Portuguese wines with the hotel's knowledgeable and friendly experts who are on hand to guide guests in their discovery of Portugal's diverse and individual wine regions

facts.text: The hotel calls itself widely regarded as the best hotel in Porto.
facts.excerpt: The Yeatman Hotel is widely regarded as the best hotel in Porto
